footnote: Figures approximate, from public reporting as of Oct 2–5, 2026. Refreshed weekly (Mondays). Always confirm current prices/valuations independently.

kpis.sub: TEMPUS AI (TEM) SITS ABOVE THE CONSENSUS TARGET WHILE THE $1.5B PERSONALIS DEAL AWAITS CLOSE
kpis.label: TEM closed at $76.63 on Oct 2 against an average analyst target of $68.56 (about 10% below price), with TTM revenue of $1.43B (+50%) but a net loss of roughly $254M. The all-stock Personalis deal ($16.25/share, ~$1.5B) was announced Aug 19 with no closing date disclosed; the Guardant litigation is unresolved.

kpis.sub: ILLUMINA (ILMN) HOLDS NEAR ITS HIGH — CONSENSUS TARGET ~$215, STOCK +108% YTD
kpis.label: ILMN added 2.75% on Oct 2 to $273.04, up about 108% from $131.16 at the start of 2026, at roughly 51x earnings. MarketBeat's consensus rating is Hold with a $214.69 average target (about 21% below price); 7.2% of shares are sold short. The turnaround is real, but the price now sits well above Street targets.

kpis.sub: RECURSION (RXRX) EXTENDS ITS RALLY, BUT 33% OF THE FLOAT IS SOLD SHORT
kpis.label: RXRX closed at $4.19 on Oct 2, up from $3.89 a week earlier, after the $42M Tempus data-license extension. GuruFocus puts its GF Value at $3.06 (about 37% overvalued) and short interest at 33.4%, among the highest in healthcare; insiders sold about $8.5M over 12 months with no open-market purchases.

kpis.sub: ARKG AUM RISES TO $2.17B FROM $2.08B; TOP-10 CONCENTRATION NOW 62.37%
kpis.label: Per StockAnalysis (Oct 2), ARKG holds 33 positions at $54.00 a share, with a trailing 1-year return of about 87% but only about 9.3% a year since its October 2014 inception. Twist (10.2%), 10x Genomics (10.0%) and Tempus (8.5%) are the top three weights; Personalis, the Tempus acquisition target, is a 4.9% holding.

themes.tag: A PRICEY DATA-PLATFORM RALLY WAITS ON ITS DEAL
themes.title: Tempus AI trades above the Street target while its Personalis acquisition remains unclosed
themes.description: TEM at $76.63 is about 10% above the $68.56 consensus target, with TTM revenue of $1.43B (+50%) and a net loss near $254M. The all-stock Personalis purchase ($16.25 a share, ~$1.5B, announced Aug 19) adds MRD testing but also integration risk and dilution, and the Guardant litigation has not moved. ARKG holds both names (TEM 8.5%, PSNL 4.9%), so the deal is a concentrated bet inside the fund.

themes.tag: THE SEQUENCING LEADER'S MULTIPLE NOW EXCEEDS THE STREET
themes.title: Illumina is up about 108% YTD at $273, with consensus at Hold and a ~$215 average target
themes.description: ILMN gained 2.75% on Oct 2 and trades near 51x earnings with a PEG around 3.9. Of 18 analysts, 10 rate it a buy, 6 hold and 2 sell, and the average target implies about 21% downside. The fundamental recovery behind the S&P 500 return is intact; the question is how much of it is already in the price.

themes.tag: CRISPR'S FIRST IN-VIVO FILING MOVES TOWARD A DECISION
themes.title: FDA accepts Intellia's BLA for lonvo-z in hereditary angioedema; in-vivo editing's regulatory clock is running
themes.description: Reporting this week says the FDA accepted Intellia's biologics license application in September following positive Phase 3 data. Acceptance is not approval and the earlier-flagged firm decision date of March 10, 2027 still governs. If cleared it would be the first in-vivo CRISPR therapy approved, but the commercial question and the cardiovascular follow-ons (Verve/Lilly, CRISPR Therapeutics) remain years from the same stage.

themes.tag: ARKG ROTATES WITHIN THE FIELD, AND ASSETS KEEP RECOVERING
themes.title: ARK has been buying Ionis, Veracyte, Beam and Scribe while trimming 10x Genomics
themes.description: Reported ARKG trades over the last two weeks show purchases of Ionis (IONS, with an FDA decision on bepirovirsen due Oct 26), Veracyte, Beam, Scribe and Guardant, funded in part by repeated sales of 10x Genomics. AUM is now $2.17B. The fund's 12-year record (about 9.3% a year) is the honest context for a trailing-year gain of about 87%.

private_watchlist.name: Isomorphic Labs
private_watchlist.note: No fresh update this week. Still targeting first trials by year-end 2026 for ISM8969 (a year behind the original 2025 target); being Alphabet-owned makes a near-term IPO unlikely regardless of how the AI-pacing debate develops elsewhere.

private_watchlist.name: Insilico Medicine
private_watchlist.note: No fresh update this week. Rentosertib's Phase III (GENESIS-IPF) remains underway with a realistic approval window of 2029-2030 per the lead investigator's own estimate — years, not quarters, from here. Still the only name in this group already public (HKEX, Dec 2025, $292M IPO).

private_watchlist.name: Xaira Therapeutics
private_watchlist.note: No fresh update this week. The company continues hiring out its business-development function to line up partnerships that supply preclinical disease-area data rather than capital — it says the $1.3B already raised covers its near-term needs — but no partner has been named and no trial has started.

private_watchlist.name: NewLimit
private_watchlist.note: No fresh update this week. Still the year's largest single disclosed longevity round (~71% of 2026's disclosed longevity funding through August); its first candidate medicine remains in large-scale manufacturing with clinical entry targeted as early as 2027.

bear_case.title: Biology still fails in the clinic — and the clock hasn't moved
bear_case.description: Zero AI-discovered drugs have reached full FDA approval out of 200+ in clinical development. Insilico's lead investigator still puts rentosertib's realistic approval at 2029-2030. Intellia's BLA acceptance is gene editing, not AI discovery — a reminder that the first approvals in this field are likely to be modalities, not platforms.

bear_case.title: Two sequencing/diagnostics leaders trade above Street targets
bear_case.description: ILMN ($273.04) sits about 21% above its $214.69 consensus target and TEM ($76.63) about 10% above its $68.56 target. Both have real operating progress (ILMN +108% YTD from a turnaround; TEM revenue +50%), but price now leads consensus.

bear_case.title: Diagnostics litigation and M&A integration remain unresolved
bear_case.description: No resolution found on Guardant v. Tempus, Tempus's appeal, or the $245.2M TwinStrand judgment against Guardant. Tempus is funding the Personalis acquisition with stock while still loss-making (net loss ~$254M TTM).

bear_case.title: Sub-scale proteomics and crowded shorts
bear_case.description: Quantum-Si trades near $1.07 with about $2.4M annualized revenue, $23.5M quarterly losses and a commercial Proteus launch not until Q2 2027; Recursion carries 33% short interest and a GF Value below its price. Both are option-value positions that can go to zero or be squeezed.

bear_case.title: The sector is running into a rate wall with a dense catalyst calendar
bear_case.description: Coverage frames XBI as hitting an interest rate wall with 40+ catalysts ahead before year-end. XBI is up roughly 53% YTD, so a single disappointing readout or hawkish rates surprise has a long way to fall. Treasury yields touching 5.1% in late September hit long-duration biotech first.
